labelCatalog.label: StartBooking
labelCatalog.note: patient.start_booking suggestion button opens the booking wizard; not a tool

selectionRule: Before hidden evaluation: select v3 iff role-filtered validation macro-F1 >= frozen v2 and accepted accuracy at v3's validation-selected threshold >= 90%; otherwise retain v2. Fixed v2 configuration only; no grid search.
repetitionRule: Same seed 20261002, one thread, identical input order, scalar CPU math. Both unfiltered and role-filtered validation top-1 labels must match exactly; maximum absolute per-label probability difference <= 1e-6. Byte-identical model ZIP is not required.

thresholdPolicy.reason: Highest coverage among nonempty fixed 0.00-0.95 (step 0.05) thresholds with accepted accuracy >=90%; tie chooses lower threshold. No additional minimum-support restriction; report accepted count explicitly.

features: Identical frozen v2 text normalization, word 1-2 + character 2,3,4 grams; L2 at each featurizer and concatenated features.
scoreSemantics: Globally normalized maximum-entropy probabilities, renormalized after catalog role mask; not calibrated on real users.
